FAQ.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.desc: Know in detail about the syllabus of our data structures course, fees and scholarship

FaqDATA.ques: What learning options are offered under this course?
FaqDATA.ans: Skillslash offers this Data Structures, Algorithms and System Design course with project certification, and gives you both offline and online learning options so you can pick what fits your schedule. There's also a blended curriculum built for working professionals, with live classes that combine hybrid learning and hands-on practical work at the project site. Live sessions let you interact with your instructor in real time, and all practical work is carried out through cloud-based services.

FaqDATA.ques: If I have to skip a lesson because of an emergency, would there be a make-up session?
FaqDATA.ans: We offer this System Design course with live online classes, and recordings of every session are made available to all students. You get unrestricted access to these recordings, so you can refer back to them whenever you need to revisit a concept for your DSA career. That said, we'd still recommend attending live classes wherever possible.

FaqDATA.ques: What if I didn't fully comprehend a module? Will I be able to take it again?
FaqDATA.ans: Yes - you can sit in on that module again with a different batch at no extra cost. This way, there's no chance of moving forward while still confused about earlier material.

FaqDATA.ques: What is Skillslash’s scholarship program for this course?
FaqDATA.ans: Under the scholarship program, every candidate takes a 20-minute online aptitude exam. Candidates who score above 65 percent are eligible for a 10 percent discount on the course fee. Unemployed candidates and mothers returning to the workforce can receive up to a 100 percent scholarship based on their exam score.

FaqDATA.ques: What kind of certification does this course provide?
FaqDATA.ans: By enrolling in this Data Structures, Algorithms and System Design course, you'll receive practical training experience reflected in your certificate. You can also avail shareable, globally acknowledged project certifications directly from the startups you're associated with for live projects.
